source: production-pattern replay derived from the existing IST arrival false-alert family and 2026-09-19 route-resolution telemetry
problem: An IST arrival can spend several ADS-B updates with its instantaneous tangent pointing toward the observer while it is already in a continuing terminal turn. Straight-line CPA may temporarily enter the alert radius before destination/history evidence fully resolves.

pre_v44_failure_mode.result: candidate can qualify from the transient tangent even though continuing curved motion remains outside the observer radius

expected_v44_behavior.alert: suppressed while the curved path disagrees with the transient straight tangent
expected_v44_behavior.release_condition: suppression disappears immediately if fresh continuing-turn geometry itself enters the configured radius, so a genuine turn toward the observer is not held behind an arbitrary delay
expected_v44_behavior.physical_inside_radius: fresh observed physical entry remains authoritative and is never suppressed by this guard
